note: Hub regression fixture: a hub repo with a genuine git submodule at projects/api (protocol.file.allow=always against a bare origin), hub config listing the project, then migrate-worktree. TestHubNoSubmoduleNoise proves the migration adds no second gitlink (only projects/api is mode 160000 on main), a project:api PM commit leaves HEAD:projects/api and main HEAD unchanged with a clean parent working tree and an in-sync submodule status, and subproject PM writes do not dirty the submodule checkout. TestHubCommit covers all three scopes in both plain and worktree layouts.
